purpose: Define a customer-operated production-shaped conformance target without claiming implementation or support.
implementation_scope: Specification and executable test plan only; no production deployment unit is implemented or supported.

identity.assumption: Customer identity federation and workload identity meet a separately accepted assurance profile.
before_m1_tests: Federation, workload identity, delegation, and revocation requirements are specified.
m1_exit_tests: Provider-neutral identity contracts pass with a test double.
before_trial_tests: Customer-operated identity conformance and recovery tests pass.

storage.assumption: Customer-selected durable stores implement capability ownership, encryption, migration, backup, and deletion contracts.
before_m1_tests: Storage, residency, retention, and migration requirements are specified.
m1_exit_tests: Portable storage contracts pass with test doubles.
before_trial_tests: Durability, restore, migration, deletion, and residency tests pass.

repository.assumption: Customer-controlled source credentials are short-lived, repository-bound, and unavailable outside isolated workers and publication adapters.
before_m1_tests: Repository and credential contracts are provider-neutral.
before_trial_tests: Customer-provider credential, revocation, and ambiguous-side-effect tests pass.

worker_isolation.assumption: The selected topology enforces tenant, filesystem, process, network, secret, compute, and time isolation.
before_m1_tests: Production-shaped isolation requirements and tests are topology-neutral.
before_trial_tests: Escape, exfiltration, resource, cancellation, and cleanup tests pass on the selected topology.

network.assumption: Ingress, service communication, and egress are authenticated, policy-enforced, observable, and deny by default.
before_m1_tests: Network trust boundaries and destination policy are specified.
m1_exit_tests: Destination and policy contracts fail closed.
before_trial_tests: Ingress, egress, DNS, redirect, and segmentation tests pass.

secrets.assumption: Customer-selected secret and key providers issue short-lived workload-scoped references without exposing material to domain state.
before_m1_tests: Secret and key provider contracts and recovery ownership are specified.
m1_exit_tests: Secret-reference and disclosure tests pass with provider doubles.
before_trial_tests: Rotation, revocation, outage, recovery, and leakage tests pass.

evidence.assumption: Evidence uses restricted writers, integrity verification, retention, disclosure policy, and independent validation.
before_m1_tests: Integrity, signing-key, retention, and unavailable-sink decisions are specified.
before_trial_tests: Tamper, key-compromise, disclosure, retention, and recovery tests pass.

telemetry.assumption: Telemetry is tenant-safe, minimized, retained separately, and promoted to evidence only through an authorized integrity step.
before_m1_tests: Telemetry ownership, residency, retention, and prohibited data are specified.
before_trial_tests: Isolation, redaction, retention, backpressure, and evidence-promotion tests pass.

backup_restore.assumption: Customer operations own encrypted backup, key recovery, restore reconciliation, and tested RTO/RPO.
before_m1_tests: Backup scope, recovery ownership, and RTO/RPO hypotheses are specified.
m1_exit_tests: Recovery contracts and state checkpoints pass.
before_trial_tests: Full restore preserves isolation, deletion, keys, evidence, and workflow state.

upgrade_rollback.assumption: Signed immutable artefacts, compatible migrations, staged rollout, rollback, and revocation are customer-operable.
before_m1_tests: Upgrade, migration, compatibility, rollback, and revocation requirements are specified.
before_trial_tests: Upgrade and rollback rehearsals pass with the same signed artefacts.

capacity_recovery.assumption: A supported envelope requires measured capacity, SLOs, admission, noisy-neighbour, provider-failure, and disaster-recovery evidence.
before_m1_tests: Required measurements and failure scenarios are specified.
m1_exit_tests: Bounded resource and recovery contracts pass.
before_trial_tests: Capacity, failover, provider outage, and disaster-recovery tests meet accepted targets.

conformance_tests.expected: The profile manifest resolves all dimensions, controls, phases, and unsupported claims.
Domain behaviour passes against replaceable provider test doubles.
All selected topology, identity, isolation, evidence, recovery, and operations checks pass before any support decision.
